text: これこそ　しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: that will remain in true Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. れきしに のこる いだいな しごと = 'a great work that will stay in history'.

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong stress on the word before it: 'this one and no other'. これこそ = 'this is the very thing'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is how old men in stories say だ, 'it is'; the long sound is him shouting. しごとじゃー = 'it's a job!'.
